message.content:
For a garden sculpture you’ll want a stone that balances **carvability** with **weather‑resistance**.  
The classic choice is **marble** – it has a fine, uniform grain that makes it easy to carve intricate details, yet it’s still robust enough to withstand outdoor conditions when properly sealed.  

Other good options include:

| Stone | Carvability | Weather Resistance | Typical Use |
|-------|-------------|--------------------|-------------|
| **Marble** | Excellent | Good (needs sealing) | Classic, detailed works |
| **Granite** | Harder to carve | Very good | Large, durable pieces |
| **Limestone** | Easy to carve | Moderate (requires maintenance) | Softer, more rustic look |
| **Sandstone** | Easy to carve | Poor (easily erodes) | Very rustic, low‑maintenance |

So if you’re looking for the most versatile and widely used material for a garden sculpture, marble is usually the top pick.
